prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1337; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company wishes to discuss the claim, they should contact us.

We request that you provide a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and any applicable excess or umbrella coverage.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, recorded statements, claim files, vehicle data, telematics information, repair records, and any electronic communications. Please ensure that this material is not altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
